svg.aria-label: The Discovery School values tree: a tree with exposed roots labelled Rooted in Christ and a colourful canopy carrying the six core values — citizenship, discipline, excellence, ingenuity, integrity and wisdom. Beside the trunk: Ready for Tomorrow.
